name: ESPN

fastest.text: Sign in at espn.com, open your profile → Account → Manage Subscription and cancel your plan.

steps: Log in to your ESPN account in a computer or mobile browser.
Hover over or tap your profile picture (top right), then select Account under Manage My Account.
Select Manage Subscription, then your subscription under Plans & Billing.
Select the plan you want to cancel, select Cancel and confirm.
note: Billed through Google, Roku, Amazon or a TV provider? Manage it with them; ESPN can't cancel those plans.

faq.q: Do I keep access after I cancel?
faq.a: Yes, until the end of your current billing cycle, and you won't be charged again.
No. ESPN doesn't give refunds or credits for partially used billing periods.

faq.q: Does cancelling delete my ESPN account?
faq.a: No. You can still log in and use the ESPN app without a subscription.
